note: What a server sends to lay out both sides and who is on them, while the match is being put together.

fields.name: padding
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: sideRoom
fields.note: How many seats side 100 has room for.

fields.name: otherSideRoom
fields.note: How many side 200 has room for.

fields.name: gap
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The players on side 100, twenty four places of a player identifier's width; the client copies as many as sideRoom says, so a server keeps sideRoom at 24 or less; a larger one has no defined effect. sideTaken says how many of the leading places carry a player, and the rest hold zero.

fields.name: otherSide
fields.note: The players on side 200, read the same way under otherSideRoom and otherSideTaken, with otherSideRoom kept at 24 or less.

fields.name: sideTaken
fields.note: How many of side 100's places carry a player.

fields.name: otherSideTaken
fields.note: How many on side 200.

fields.name: padding
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: sideRoom
fields.note: How many seats the first side has room for, and so how many leading places of side a client copies. A server sends at most 24: a client refuses a count above 48 and keeps the one before, and for 25 to 48 copies on past the side's places into the fields after them.

fields.name: otherSideRoom
fields.note: How many the other has room for, under the same terms.

fields.name: gap
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The players on one side, twenty four places. A client copies as many leading places as sideRoom gives; the rest hold zero. A place cannot be read on its own, because zero is an identifier a match gives out as well as what an unused place holds. It has a player identifier's width.

fields.name: otherSide
fields.note: The players on the other, under the same reading, as many as otherSideRoom gives.

fields.name: sideTaken
fields.note: How many of the leading places on the first side carry a player. A client keeps it, and it limits nothing.

fields.name: otherSideTaken
fields.note: How many on the other, under the same terms.

fields.name: sideRoom
fields.note: How many seats the first side has room for.

fields.name: otherSideRoom
fields.note: How many the other has room for.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The players on one side, twenty four places. The count below says how many of the leading places carry a player; the rest hold zero. A place cannot be read on its own, because zero is an identifier a match gives out as well as what an unused place holds. It has a player identifier's width.

fields.name: otherSide
fields.note: The players on the other, under the same reading and its own count.

fields.name: sideTaken
fields.note: How many of the leading places on the first side carry a player.

fields.name: otherSideTaken
fields.note: How many on the other.
